svg.title: Jerez (Sherry) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Jerez; 2: Sanlúcar de Barrameda; 3: El Puerto de Santa María; 4: Chipiona; 5: Rota; 6: Chiclana de la Frontera; 7: Trebujena; 8: Cádiz

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water
